items.name: answer-key.json
items.purpose: Hidden task keys and issue key vocabulary; retain through blind scoring and final independent audit, then recycle after parent acceptance.

items.name: measurement-ledger.json
items.purpose: One row per authorized native cell, including unattempted cells and stop state; private through ticket close.

items.name: review-receipt.json
items.purpose: Raw blind reviewer response, exact hashes, reviewer provenance, and deterministic schema validation; private through final audit.

items.name: review-dispatch-trace.json
items.purpose: Exact dispatched review task, canonical agent identity returned by collaboration, completed status, and response hash, bound by the review envelope; private through final audit.

items.name: kiro-session-cleanup.json
items.purpose: Exact captured V2 session deletions, complete before/after tuple-set verification, and preservation of unrelated sessions; private through parent close.

items.name: native-cell-receipt.json
items.purpose: Requested and served model when emitted, elapsed time, native usage/cost, terminal state, and raw stream hashes; private until final audit.
